pool.text: Kumasi became the capital of the Ashanti Empire due to Osei Tutu activities.
The Ashanti empire became the primary state among the Ashantis after victory.
Kumasi was documented to have contained twenty seven streets during Bowdich visit.
Parts of Kumasi royal residence were burnt by the British forces.
Manhyia Palace opened in Kumasi and now functions as a museum.
Kumasi was vested with ceremonial control over Ashanti sub states.
The full role of king was restored by the colonial administration.
The Rex Cinema opened in Kumasi as the first documented movie.
Maxwell Fry published his garden city plan for Kumasi city.
A second movie theatre holding fifteen hundred seats was built.
The College of Technology first opened in Kumasi city.
Kumasi hospital opened and was initially named Kumasi Central hospital.
Kumasi became the capital of the Ashanti Region after independence.
The Department of Architecture in Kumasi admitted its first students.
KNUST transitioned from a college to a university institution.
The Asantehene Palace was built as a royal Asante attraction.
Only twelve percent of households had unshared toilets in Kumasi.
A study found that home owners own homes and migrants dominate.
The city introduced metro bus services for public road transport.
A project to upgrade the railways was due to get underway.
